raw_record.interpretation: Canva provides multi-brand asset management and template editing at $18/month for solo operators or $25/seat/month for teams, establishing a published incumbent pricing baseline for graphic generation.
raw_record.observation: Canva publishes US pricing: Free tier at $0 with 1 brand kit (3 colors only); Canva Pro at $18/month ($180/year) for 1 person including 5 brand kits; Canva Business at $25/person/month ($250/year/person) including 100 brand kits and approval workflows.
raw_record.source_excerpt: Canva Free is $0/yr for 1 person. Canva Pro is $180/yr or $18/mo for 1 person. Canva Business is $250/yr or $25/mo per person billed annually.

raw_record.interpretation: Canva natively supports multi-brand asset separation for up to 5 client brands on Pro and 100 on Business, covering the brand isolation requirement for solo and boutique agencies within their existing design tool.
raw_record.observation: Canva Brand Kit documentation specifies plan limits: Free tier includes 1 brand kit with up to 3 colors; Pro includes up to 5 brand kits; Business/Teams includes up to 100 brand kits; Enterprise supports up to 1,000 brand kits. Kits store logos, color palettes, fonts, brand templates, and up to 2,000 custom assets per category.
raw_record.source_excerpt: Free: 1 Brand Kit (limited to 3 colors only). Pro: 5 Brand Kits. Business / Teams: 100 Brand Kits. Enterprise: Up to 1,000 Brand Kits.

raw_record.interpretation: Batch production from structured data is natively available in Canva Pro/Business, but the resulting batch output is decoupled from direct scheduling, requiring manual separation before queueing.
raw_record.observation: Canva Bulk Create documentation shows users can upload CSV/XLSX or enter table data to map text and images to template placeholders, generating up to 300 pages or individual designs. However, Canva officially documents that Content Planner cannot schedule multi-design bulk files directly without copying each design into a single-design file.
raw_record.source_excerpt: The Content Planner is not currently compatible with multi-design documents. As a workaround, copy the design you want to schedule into a new single-design and schedule it separately.

raw_record.interpretation: Incumbent approval software charges per client workspace with unlimited client and internal seats, establishing a published $39-$59/workspace/month pricing benchmark for multi-brand review and approval workflows.
raw_record.observation: Planable publishes pricing billed per client workspace rather than per user: Basic is $39/workspace/month (60 posts, 4 pages, unlimited users, optional approvals); Pro is $59/workspace/month (150 posts, 10 pages, unlimited users, Required approvals and team-only drafts).
raw_record.source_excerpt: Basic: $39/workspace/mo ($32.50 billed annually), 60 posts/workspace, 4 social pages, unlimited team users. Pro: $59/workspace/mo ($49.17 billed annually), 150 posts/workspace, 10 social pages, unlimited team users, multi-level approvals.

raw_record.interpretation: Multi-brand review, revision feedback, and client approval are explicitly addressed by dedicated approval suites like Planable on a per-workspace basis, providing an incumbent substitute for the client review stage.
raw_record.observation: Planable documentation states that plans organize work by workspace (one per client brand), providing unlimited client and internal reviewers in-context comment and annotation tools directly on post mockups, alongside optional or required multi-tiered approval gates before scheduling.
raw_record.source_excerpt: Planable organizes work by workspace (one per client brand). Supports in-context comments directly on visual post mockups, team-only drafts and internal notes, and multi-level required approvals before publishing.
